questions.prompt: As of writing, which metric carries the largest weight in the Lighthouse performance score?
questions.explanation: As of writing (Lighthouse 10/11) the weights are FCP 10, SI 10, LCP 25, TBT 30, CLS 25. TBT has the largest single weight, so heavy main-thread JavaScript hurts the score most.

questions.prompt: Total Blocking Time is the lab proxy for which Core Web Vital? ____ (three-letter abbreviation).
questions.explanation: Lighthouse can't measure INP without a real user, so it uses TBT (main-thread blocking during load) as the lab proxy for responsiveness.

questions.prompt: Which statements about Lighthouse are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: By default it emulates a mid-tier mobile device with throttling
It is a lab tool and does not measure INP directly
A score of 100 guarantees good field Core Web Vitals
It can run in DevTools, from the CLI, or via PageSpeed Insights

questions.explanation: Lighthouse defaults to a throttled mobile profile, is a lab tool without direct INP, and runs in DevTools/CLI/PSI. A 100 is a lab result and doesn't guarantee good field vitals.

questions.prompt: Match each Lighthouse report section to what it contains.

pairs.right: Suggested fixes with estimated time savings
Supporting info like main-thread work and third-party cost
Things the page already does well

questions.explanation: Metrics are the numbers; Opportunities estimate savings; Diagnostics give context; Passed audits list what's already good. Savings in Opportunities are estimates.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't a Lighthouse score of 100 guarantee a good real-world experience?

options.text: Because Lighthouse only tests the homepage
Because it is a lab test on one device profile and doesn't measure INP; real users differ

questions.explanation: The score reflects one throttled lab run and excludes INP (using TBT). Real users span many devices and networks, so field data must confirm the experience.

questions.prompt: Order the Lighthouse score bands from worst to best.
questions.explanation: Lighthouse colours the score 0–49 red, 50–89 orange, and 90–100 green.
